name: WBJet-HelloTap
author: dhirajsharma

sections.description:
WBJet-HelloTap adds professional-looking, highly customizable floating WhatsApp and Call buttons to your WordPress website. Make it easy for your visitors to contact you directly through WhatsApp or phone calls.

Features:

  • Customizable WhatsApp and Call buttons
  • Device-specific visibility settings
  • Adjustable positions and colors
  • Custom button text options
  • Multiple WhatsApp link types
  • Device-specific margins
  • Z-index control
  • Easy to set up and use
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/wbjet-hellotap directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. Use the Settings->WBJet HelloTap screen to configure the plugin
sections.faq:
Can I customize the button colors?

Yes, you can choose custom colors for both WhatsApp and Call buttons using the color picker in the settings.

Can I control where the buttons appear?

Yes, you can set the buttons to appear on desktop, tablet, and mobile devices independently.
